register: Initiative & solutions register — DAMM v1.7 diagnostic, gauntlet loop 1
protocol: DAMM-v1.6-Source-Tier-Protocol (T4-T5 admissible for existence facts only; results claims T1-T3)

entries.name: Farmer Card (Kart el-Fallah) smart card programme
entries.lead: MALR with MCIT; Meeza card rails (state fintech e-Finance)
entries.scale: 3.5m cards printed, 2m distributed by Dec 2021 (official); from May 2026 the card is the sole approved payment method for subsidised fertilizer at cooperatives nationwide (news-reported)
entries.results: No independent (T1-T3) outcome evaluation found; coverage figures are government-reported
entries.src: MCIT-MALR joint press release, 6 Dec 2021 (accessed 2026-08-22); corroborated by Amwal Al Ghad, 10 May 2026 (T5), https://en.amwalalghad.com/egypt-kicks-off-summer-fertiliser-season-with-full-switch-to-digital-payments/
entries.verification_note: Cumulative card count as of 2026 not found. Al-Ahram Weekly Nov 2021 article and e-Finance Agrinet platform page both returned 403/rejected on access date, so the operating platform behind the card could not be independently profiled.

entries.name: Digitised subsidised-fertilizer distribution ('the fertilizer system')
entries.lead: MALR (agricultural cooperatives; Meeza/Farmer Card payment rails)
entries.scale: Nationwide; 2026 summer season fully cashless with 5,500 electronic POS across 27 governorates and 6.6m fertilizer bags in the first tranche (news-reported, T5)
entries.results: Officials claim fairer distribution and reduced subsidy leakage; no T1-T3 verification found
entries.src: MALR official website, 'The fertilizer system' highlight (accessed 2026-08-22); scale figures from Amwal Al Ghad, 10 May 2026 (T5), https://en.amwalalghad.com/egypt-kicks-off-summer-fertiliser-season-with-full-switch-to-digital-payments/
entries.verification_note: Anti-leakage effects are official statements, not evaluated results. Desk report attributed fertilizer governance to 'AgriMisr' — mischaracterised; see issues.

entries.name: Hudhud smart farmer assistant (AI pest & advisory app)
entries.scale: Soft-launched Dec 2021; still an active flagship in MCIT-MALR programme reviews as of Jul 2024; no user/download figures published at any tier
entries.src: MCIT-MALR joint press release, 6 Dec 2021 (accessed 2026-08-22); continuity confirmed by MCIT press release, 25 Jul 2024, https://mcit.gov.eg/en/Media_Center/Press_Room/Press_Releases/67819; existence also noted in ICARDA 2023 (T2)
entries.verification_note: Two official press releases (2021, 2024) plus an ICARDA report confirm existence and continuity; usage and accuracy claims could not be verified.

entries.name: El-Mufeed in Food and Agriculture digital extension app (desk report's 'Al Mufeed' and 'FAO El-Mufeed' — one initiative)
entries.scale: Promoted to extension agents in all governorates (148 participants at Dec 2020 national rollout meeting); no download figures published
entries.results: Egyptian Knowledge Bank journal evaluations (2023, El-Gharbia and Assiut) reportedly rated app quality medium-to-high (~85% of officials) with internet/hardware obstacles — EKB deep links did not resolve on access date, so this results claim ships unconfirmed
entries.src: FAO Egypt news, 22 Dec 2020 (accessed 2026-08-22); launch page: https://www.fao.org/egypt/our-office/the-fao-digital-app-of---el-mufeed-in-food-and-agriculture/ (31 Mar 2020)
entries.verification_note: Deduplicated: desk report listed 'Al Mufeed and DAIRS apps' and 'FAO El-Mufeed digital extension model' as separate initiatives; they are the same app. Last independently dated activity is 2023 evaluation literature; 2026 operational status not re-confirmed.

entries.name: DAIRS (climate early-warning / agro-advisory system)
entries.lead: Attributed to MALR (per ICARDA); lead not independently confirmed
entries.src: ICARDA, 'Current Situation of Digital Agriculture in Egypt' (2023), MELSpace record (accessed 2026-08-22)
entries.verification_note: Weakest entry retained: sole trace is a passing mention in ICARDA 2023 describing DAIRS as a climate early-warning system in development. No official MALR/MCIT source, app-store listing, or news coverage found. Kept because the source is T2; flag for drop if loop 2 finds nothing.

entries.name: Cropping-pattern satellite/AI programme + agricultural holdings automation (Digital Egypt, MCIT-MALR)
entries.scale: Deployed for six major crops across five governorates as of Jul 2024 (official)
entries.verification_note: This row also covers the desk report's generic 'MCIT Digital Egypt agricultural services' candidate; the umbrella programme's other components (Farmer Card, Hudhud) have their own rows.

entries.scale: Qena governorate; farmer/feddan figures not published on project page

entries.name: Mozare3 (agri-fintech & contract farming platform)
entries.lead: Private — co-founded by Hussein Abou Bakr, launched 2021
entries.funding: Reported >US$10m raised (EgyptInnovate/MCIT portal, May 2026 — portal-reported, not independently audited)
entries.src: EgyptInnovate (MCIT-affiliated portal) success story, 24 May 2026 (accessed 2026-08-22); existence corroborated by UNDP Digital Agribusiness Map, Jul 2025 (T4), https://www.undp.org/sites/g/files/zskgke326/files/2025-07/undp_agribusiness_digital_map.pdf

entries.name: FreshSource (B2B fresh-produce marketplace & logistics)
entries.lead: Private — founded by Farah Amara and Omar Amara
entries.scale: Serves hotels, restaurants, retailers, e-commerce and hospitals; farmer/volume figures not independently published
entries.src: UNDP Digital Agribusiness Map: Agri Tech & Climate-Smart Agriculture in Egypt, Jul 2025 (accessed 2026-08-22); current operations corroborated by StartupHub.today editorial, 15 Aug 2026 (T5), https://www.startuphub.today/en/editorial/freshsource-egyptian-startup-uses-tech-to-streamline-food-supply-chains-2846

entries.src: GSMA Mobile for Development organisation profile (accessed 2026-08-22); current positioning per vendor site (T5), https://www.zr3i.com/en

entries.name: Wheat silo automation & grain storage digitisation
entries.lead: Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade / Egyptian Holding Company for Silos & Storage, with IBM and ACME SAICO
entries.scale: 22 silos automated by end-2021 with stated plans toward 400 sites (vendor-reported); modernisation programme and FY2026/27 budget approved per Jun 2026 news
entries.results: Leakage-reduction and visibility claims are vendor/ministerial statements; no T1-T3 evaluation found
entries.src: IBM MEA newsroom, 26 Sep 2021 (vendor, existence facts only; accessed 2026-08-22); ongoing status per Daily News Egypt, 14 Jun 2026 (T5), https://www.dailynewsegypt.com/2026/06/14/egypt-advances-silo-modernisation-efforts-to-safeguard-strategic-grain-reserves/
entries.verification_note: All scale figures vendor-reported per protocol. State Information Service page carrying the PM's Mar 2026 grain-system statement could not be fetched (TLS certificate error) on access date.

overlap_finding: The dominant structural overlap is in ADVISORY/EXTENSION CONTENT: at least four public or donor channels deliver farmer advisory in parallel — Hudhud (MALR/MCIT, AI), El-Mufeed (FAO-MALR), DAIRS (announced), GIZ AIP II online advisory — plus private channels (Zr3i, Yalla Mozare3), with no evidence of a shared content backbone even between the two government-linked apps that target the same extension service. Second overlap: FARMER REGISTRATION/ID — the Farmer Card registry, the fertilizer system's holding records, the MCIT holdings-automation project, and each donor project (SAIL) and startup (Mozare3) maintain separate farmer/beneficiary registries; the Farmer Card is the only asset behaving as shared infrastructure (registry + Meeza payments) that another system (fertilizer distribution) demonstrably reuses. Third overlap: SATELLITE CROP MONITORING is being built at least three times — the MCIT-MALR cropping-pattern programme, FAO water-productivity/water-accounting work, and Zr3i — with no documented data-sharing between them.
issues: 1) Desk-report corrections: 'Al Mufeed' and 'FAO El-Mufeed' are the same app (deduplicated into one row); 'AgriMisr fertilizer governance system' is mischaracterised — AgriMisr (agrimisr.com) is a private agri-input e-commerce marketplace, while fertilizer governance is the MALR smart-card system (row 2); AgriMisr was not entered (existence verifiable only via vendor site/Facebook). 2) Farmtopia (farmtopia.farm, Egyptian farm-management SaaS) exists but only via vendor site and F6S (T5); judged below significance threshold and not entered — do not confuse with the EU Horizon 'Farmtopia' project (farmtopia.eu). 3) 'MCIT Digital Egypt agricultural services' is an umbrella, represented across rows 1, 3 and 6 rather than as its own row. 4) Unresolvable links on access date: EKB journal evaluations of El-Mufeed (connection reset — the row's results claim is therefore flagged unconfirmed), english.ahram.org.eg (403), efinance.com.eg/portfolio/agrinet (request rejected), sis.gov.eg (TLS error). 5) Protocol rule 3 (Wayback archives for T4-T5 links) not executed in this pass — flag for capture in loop 2. 6) WebSearch tool budget was exhausted session-wide; verification used direct browser search (Bing) plus deep-link fetches, which may have reduced recall of Arabic-language sources.
